isolation.executed: the compiled kernel reads this edge list
isolation.emitter_W: left untouched. The dense (n, n) W field is not read by kernel=baseline; zeroing it yields a bit-identical spike train

single_realization.configured: reduce the construction to the single neuron at V1_1.L5.E
single_realization.executed: the compiled kernel sees one neuron and no edges

execution.checked: v at every step of every chunk

gate_scope: only the execution check applies. Collapse, runaway, synchrony, drift and propagation are defined over areas and populations that a one-neuron model does not have, so they are not evaluated rather than trivially passed

isi.observable: interspike interval of the single cell

final_window.reading: pooled over every cell's own intervals. The per_cell_mean spread says how much the period varies between cells, which for identical parameters can differ only through v0 and the noise draw

whole_run.reading: pooled over every cell's own intervals. The per_cell_mean spread says how much the period varies between cells, which for identical parameters can differ only through v0 and the noise draw

oscillation.signal: the single cell's spike train in 1 ms bins, expressed in Hz
oscillation.caveat: with one cell the population rate is a spike train, so peak_autocorr is a property of the interval structure and its null is the single-cell Poisson null
